                        ( p. 799 ) H کادا कादा kādā [S. कर्द + कः ], s.m. Mud, mire, &c. ( = kādo , q.v.). 2) کادر kādar
                        ( p. 799 ) H کادر कादर kādar ( = kātar , q.v.), adj. & s.m. Cowardly, timid, &c. — a coward. 3) کادرائي kādarāʼī
                        ( p. 799 ) H کادرائي कादराई kādarāʼī = H کادري कादरी kādarī [S. कातर + ता + इका ], s.f. Cowardice, pusillanimity, timidity, fear, &c. ( = kātaratā , q.v.). 4) کادري kādarī
                        ( p. 799 ) H کادري कादरी kādarī = H کادرائي कादराई kādarāʼī [S. कातर + ता + इका ], s.f. Cowardice, pusillanimity, timidity, fear, &c. ( = kātaratā , q.v.). 5) کدا kadā
                        ( p. 820 ) S کدا कदा kadā , adv. When? at what time? — once upon a time; perhaps: — kadāpi ( kadā + api ], adv. Sometimes, now and then; ever, at all, on any account, in any wise or case (generally followed by a negative): — kadā-ćit , or kadā-ća , vulg. kadāć , At some time or other, sometimes, once; ever, if (with a negative); should; possibly, probably, perhaps, perchance, if, if perchance, peradventure. 6) کداپي kādāpi
                        ( p. 820 ) S کداپي कदापि kādāpi , adv. See s.v. kādā . 7) کداچت kadā-ćit
                        ( p. 820 ) S کداچت कदाचित् kadā-ćit , adv. See s.v. kadā . 8) کدر kadar
                        ( p. 821 ) S کدر कदर kadar , s.m. A saw; an elephant-goad; — a white sort of Mimosa. 9) کدر kadar
                        ( p. 821 ) A کدر kadar (inf. n. of کدر 'to be turbid,' &c.), s.m. Being turbid or muddy; turbidness, muddiness, dirtiness; perturbation, agitation (of mind), trouble, affliction, solicitude (cf. kudūrat ). 10) کدل kadal
                        ( p. 821 ) S کدل कदल kadal , = S کدلك कदलक kadalak , s.m. The plantain or banana tree ( = kadalī ); the leaf of the plantain. 11) کدلك kadalak
                        ( p. 821 ) S کدلك कदलक kadalak , = S کدل कदल kadal , s.m. The plantain or banana tree ( = kadalī ); the leaf of the plantain. 12) کدلی kadalī, kadlī
                        ( p. 821 ) S کدلی कदली kadalī , vulg. kadlī , s.f. The plantain or banana, Musa sapientum , or M. paradisiaca ; — a kind of deer; a banner: — kadalī-patra , s.m. A plantain-leaf. 13) کدم kadam
                        ( p. 821 ) H کدم कदम kadam , s.m. = kadamb , q.v. 14) کدمب kadamb
                        ( p. 821 ) S کدمب कदम्ब kadamb , s.m. The tree Nauclea cadamba ; — an assemblage or collection, a multitude, crowd; plenty: — kadamb-pushpī , s.f. A plant (commonly called Mandīri ) the flowers of which resemble those of the Kadamb . 15) کدن kadan
                        ( p. 821 ) S کدن कदन kadan , s.m. Destroying, killing, destruction, slaughter; — killer, destroyer; destructive creature. 16) کده kada
                        ( p. 821 ) P کده kada [Pehl. kadak , katak ; Zend kata , rt. kan = S. khan ], s.m. Habitation, house; place, &c. (used as last member of comp., e.g. ātash-kada , 'place of fire,' a temple of the Magi; — mai-kada , 'a wine-cellar,' 'a tavern — mātam-kada , 'a house of mourning'). 17) کدهن kadahiṅ, kad-hiṅ
                        ( p. 821 ) H کدهن कदहिं kadahiṅ , kad-hiṅ = H کدهو कदहू kadahū , कदहु kadahu , कधू kadhū = H کدهون कधूं kadhūṅ = H کدهي कधी kadhī = H کدهين कधीं kadhīṅ ( kad + emphat. part. hū or hī , qq.v.), adv. = kabhī , q.v.). 18) کدهو kadahū, kadahu, kadhū
                        ( p. 821 ) H کدهو कदहू kadahū , कदहु kadahu , कधू kadhū = H کدهن कदहिं kadahiṅ , kad-hiṅ = H کدهون कधूं kadhūṅ = H کدهي कधी kadhī = H کدهين कधीं kadhīṅ ( kad + emphat. part. hū or hī , qq.v.), adv. = kabhī , q.v.). Search Form • DDSA Close
